banner: Prototype. kycBank is a fictional bank. Nothing you type leaves your browser.

welcome.title: Open a kycBank account
welcome.lead: New in Belgium? Open your account from your phone. First we'll tell you exactly what you need, so nothing surprises you halfway.
points: Four questions to see what applies to you
Your personal document list before any form starts
A clear answer at the end: what happens next and when

eligibility.title: A few questions first
eligibility.lead: Your answers decide which documents you'll need. You can change them later.

questions.why_we_ask: Banks must know where you live. If you're not registered at your commune yet, we'll ask for other proof instead.

options.label: In Belgium, and I'm registered at my commune
In Belgium, but not registered at my commune yet
Abroad, and I'm moving to Belgium soon

questions.text: Do you have itsme or a Belgian eID card?
questions.why_we_ask: With itsme or a Belgian eID we can confirm who you are in a minute. Without one, you'll photograph your passport instead. Both work.

account.title: Which account do you need?
account.basic_right: Everyone legally living in the EU has a right to a basic payment account in Belgium. If another bank turned you down, you can ask for one here.

checklist.title: Your document list
checklist.lead: Have these ready before you continue. Nothing is uploaded on this screen.

id.label: Your passport or national ID card
id.why: The law requires us to check who you are.

permit.label: Your Belgian residence permit, or the document your commune gave you while it's being made
permit.why: It shows you're allowed to live in Belgium.

moving.label: Proof you're moving to Belgium, such as your employment contract
moving.why: We can only open accounts for people who live, or will soon live, in Belgium.

address.label: Proof of your address in Belgium: a rental contract or a recent utility bill
address.why: Needed only if your commune registration isn't done yet. We'll tell you if you can skip it.

payslip.label: A recent payslip or pension statement
payslip.why: It confirms where your money comes from.

contract.label: Your employment contract, or a recent statement for your savings or business income
contract.why: It confirms where your money comes from.

funds_other.label: Proof of where the money comes from. We'll tell you what fits your case.
funds_other.why: The law asks for more detail when the source isn't clear yet.

itsme.label: itsme on your phone, or your Belgian eID card and a card reader
itsme.why: The fastest way to confirm who you are.

camera.label: A phone camera, for a photo of your passport and a short selfie
camera.why: Without itsme, this is how we confirm the passport is yours.

consent.title: How we use your details
points: We ask for your details because EU anti-money-laundering law requires it. That is the legal basis, so we don't need your consent for it.
We use them to check who you are, decide which checks apply, and keep your file up to date.
We keep them for as long as the law requires after you leave us, then delete them.
In this prototype nothing is stored or sent anywhere.
consent.optional: Optional: send me tips and offers by email. You can stop them any time.
consent.agree: I've read how kycBank uses my details

identity.title: Confirm who you are
identity.simulated: Simulated step. No real identity check happens in this prototype.

route_doc.note: Takes a few minutes. A colleague may check your photos.

identity.eid_done: Identity confirmed (simulated). We received your name, date and place of birth, and nationality from itsme.
identity.doc_done: Photos received (simulated). Now type your details as they appear on your passport.
identity.why_we_ask: EU law lists exactly what a bank must check: your names, date and place of birth, nationality and where you live.

due_diligence.title: About your account
due_diligence.lead: Five short questions. Each one says why we ask.

result.title: Your result
result.illustrative: Illustrative result. kycBank's tier table is a prototype, not a real risk model.
result.address_needed: One more thing: we need your address in Belgium.

now_steps: Your debit card arrives by post.
Log in to the kycBank app to see your account.
Your salary can be paid in as soon as you share your account number with your employer.
review_steps: Send the extra documents listed below from the app.
A colleague reviews your application. We'll message you when it's done.
Your account opens once the review is complete.

review_docs.proof_of_source_of_funds: Proof of where the money comes from
review_docs.proof_of_address: Proof of your address in Belgium

done.next_review: We'll ask you to check your details again by {date}.

notice.title: Time to check your details, {name}
notice.reason_periodic: We last checked your details {years} years ago. EU law asks banks to keep them up to date, at least every five years for most customers.
notice.reason_expired: Your identity document on file has also expired.
notice.consequence: You can keep using your account as normal. If we haven't heard from you by then, we'll remind you, and we may have to limit some services until it's done.
notice.effort: Most of it is already filled in. You only confirm what's still right and update what isn't.

datause.title: How we use your details
points: We keep your details up to date because EU anti-money-laundering law requires it. That's the legal basis, so we don't need your consent.
We only ask again for what is missing, out of date or changed.
In this prototype nothing is stored or sent anywhere.
datause.agree: I've read how kycBank uses my details

review.title: Is this still right?
review.lead: Tap Change for anything that's different. Items marked Action needed must be done.
review.locked: To correct this, contact us: it needs a check of your identity document.

update.title: Update what changed
update.renew_eid: Read my new eID with itsme (simulated)
update.renew_doc: Take a photo of my new ID card (simulated)
update.why_id: An expired document can't confirm who you are any more, so we need the new one.

done.title: Thank you, your details are up to date (simulated)
done.title_review: Thank you. A colleague will look at the changes (simulated)
done.next_review: We'll ask you to check them again by {date}.
done.review_note: Because of what changed, the extra checks now apply. We'll message you if we need anything else.
done.compare: A full re-onboarding would have asked for {full} items.
